# Accessibility Evaluation Report: Example Kiosk Portal

## Outcomes

| Criterion | Outcome | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| 2.1.1 Keyboard | failed | Checkout fare slider blocks keyboard purchase |
| 2.4.7 Focus Visible | passed | Focus indicator sufficient on every element measured |
| 3.1.2 Language of Parts | untested | Nothing evaluated this criterion this cycle |

Random sample selected by seeded shuffle of the sitemap (seed 4242). Support baseline as evaluated: NVDA 2026.1 + Firefox; keyboard-only.

## Findings

Severity is impact on the person, orthogonal to the outcomes above.

- a11y_checkout_slider_keyboard — CRITICAL — drag-only slider; purchase blocked by keyboard, alternative input absent.
- a11y_icon_button_name — MINOR — icon-only button unnamed; direct text fallback exists.
- a11y_footer_link_contrast — MINOR — footer links measured 4.2:1.

## Coverage Boundary

The ticket kiosk screens sit outside the web measurement stack; the manual session of 2026-07-15 covered them.

## Evaluation Statement

Withheld: failed outcomes remain open, and sampling alone would still be an insufficient basis for a product-wide claim.
